name: review-discipline
description: Structured reviewer-pass disciplines for code, specs, and test fixtures: apply a fixed verification taxonomy as an executable contract (run before you conclude), and emit findings keyed to named rows/checks with severity and a verdict. Three skills: review-code (code-vs-architecture/contract), review-spec (prose-vs-code fidelity), and review-fixtures (fixture-data-vs-declared-testing-intent).
